{{Top|leg}}
'''Somatoll''' was a drug that could be used to tranquilize a large number of [[Species/Legends|species]]. [[Ramoan]]s were known to have a [[Death/Legends|fatal]] reaction to the drug.<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> 

In [[43 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used darts laced with somatoll to subdue Jedi Knights [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] and [[Bazel Warv]] when they succumbed to the same [[Force psychosis|madness]] afflicting the other Jedi.<ref name="abyss" />
